gates.requirement: Independent assembly, chemical graph, atom map and local structural reference checks for all eligible cases
Analytic metric controls plus AAV9 and six unrelated nonviral development cases, including linked glycans
gates.evidence: Analytic controls and AAV9 plus six supported external complexes execute; 1QFO failure retained. 1PWB and 2VUZ share a broad C-type lectin fold, so six unrelated nonviral families are not established.

gates.requirement: Frozen eligible families, leakage audit, precision target, independent tested specificity labels
Paired information, conformation and assembly comparisons, failure denominators, family-aware uncertainty
Independent end-to-end replay from archived sources and raw outputs
gates.evidence: Separate parser and actual one-seed replay, clean-environment source-to-12-run replay, and all-table archive recomputation pass on the same host. Cross-platform/final scientific reference adjudication remains outside these checks.

interpretation: Development oracle redocking can validate implementation. It cannot establish blind site recovery, molecular specificity, or universal docking reliability.

completed_milestone.description: Executed and reproducible development diagnostics; original scientific purpose remains incomplete
